Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale (Colombia-wide) spatial modeling of land use/land cover (LULC) change—specifically deforestation—using the Dinamica EGO platform. Its primary objective is to model and predict future deforestation under two distinct quantitative scenarios: Business-as-Usual (BAU) and Governance (GOV), with projections to 2030 and 2050. The study uses spatially explicit drivers, applies quantitative accuracy metrics (implied through calibrated scenario modeling based on historical forest loss data from Hansen et al.), and produces mapped deforestation projections. It meets all core inclusion criteria: national-scale focus, primary emphasis on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with comparative analysis, spatially explicit modeling, and mapped outputs. It does not trigger any exclusion criteria—it is not global, local, species-focused, economic-only, methodological without application, or limited to a single scenario.)
